narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project.
finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the bundler now sends `retryCount`. Fixed in [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6). `isBackoffEnabled` threw on an unset flag. The new loader gives `undefined`, not `false`. Fixed in [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7).

The 8 warnings are still there. They are deprecation notices, harmless for now.

Next: fix `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` before v5.
